issues.detail: The Hebrew says 'the LORD who made Moses and Aaron' (עָשָׂה אֶת מֹשֶׁה וְאֶת אַהֲרֹן), i.e., who appointed/established them, but the Chinese renders it as 'the one who created Moses and Aaron' (創造摩西和亞倫), which could imply physical creation rather than appointing/establishing their roles. This changes the meaning.

The Hebrew includes 'and who brought your fathers up from the land of Egypt' (וַאֲשֶׁר הֶעֱלָה אֶת אֲבֹתֵיכֶם מֵאֶרֶץ מִצְרָיִם). The Chinese omits this entire clause, losing a substantive part of the verse.
